<template>
  <view class="home-page">
    <view class="home-header">
      <view class="home-title-row">
        <view class="title">今日好物</view>
        <text class="home-subtitle">精选限时优惠</text>
      </view>
      <image class="home-banner" src="/assets/home/banner.png" mode="aspectFill" />
    </view>

    <view class="category-tabs">
      <view
        class="category-tab"
        wx:for="{{categories}}"
        wx:key="id"
        wx:class="{{ {active: item.id === activeCategory} }}"
        bindtap="switchCategory(item.id)"
      >
        <text>{{item.name}}</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="product-grid">
      <product-card
        wx:for="{{products}}"
        wx:key="id"
        product="{{item}}"
        bindselect="openProduct"
        bindaddcart="addToCart"
      />
    </view>

    <view wx:if="{{loading}}" class="loading-row">
      <text>商品加载中...</text>
    </view>
    <view wx:elif="{{!products.length}}" class="empty-state">
      <text>当前分类暂无商品</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    activeCategory: 'featured',
    categories: [
      { id: 'featured', name: '精选' },
      { id: 'fresh', name: '生鲜' },
      { id: 'home', name: '家居' },
      { id: 'digital', name: '数码' }
    ],
    products: [
      {
        id: 'sku-1001',
        title: '云南高山蓝莓 4 盒装',
        subtitle: '产地直发 · 当日采摘',
        cover: '/assets/products/blueberry.png',
        price: '39.90',
        originalPrice: '59.90',
        salesText: '已售 2.3 万件',
        tag: '限时直降'
      },
      {
        id: 'sku-1002',
        title: '便携式手冲咖啡套装',
        subtitle: '办公室也能喝现磨',
        cover: '/assets/products/coffee.png',
        price: '129.00',
        originalPrice: '169.00',
        salesText: '已售 8600 件',
        tag: '新品'
      }
    ],
    loading: false
  },
  methods: {
    switchCategory (categoryId) {
      if (categoryId === this.activeCategory) return
      this.activeCategory = categoryId
      this.fetchProducts()
    },
    fetchProducts () {
      this.loading = true
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/mall/products',
        data: { category: this.activeCategory },
        success: ({ data }) => {
          this.products = data.list
        },
        complete: () => {
          this.loading = false
        }
      })
    },
    openProduct ({ detail }) {
      wx.navigateTo({
        url: `/packageProduct/pages/detail/index?id=${detail.productId}`
      })
    },
    addToCart ({ detail }) {
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/cart/items',
        method: 'POST',
        data: { productId: detail.productId, count: 1 },
        success: () => {
          wx.showToast({ title: '已加入购物车', icon: 'success' })
        }
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>

<style>
.home-page {
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 24rpx;
  background: #f6f7fb;
}

}

}

}

}

  border-radius: 18rpx;
}

image {

  border-radius: 0;
}

}

}

.empty-state {

  font-size: 26rpx;
  text-align: center;
}
</style>

<script type="application/json">
{
  "navigationBarTitleText": "今日好物",
  "enablePullDownRefresh": true,
  "onReachBottomDistance": 80,
  "usingComponents": {
    "product-card": "../../components/product-card"
  }
}
</script>

---PRODUCT CARD---
<template>
  <view class="product-card" bindtap="selectProduct">
    <view class="product-cover-wrap">
      <image class="product-cover" src="{{product.cover}}" mode="aspectFill" />
      <text wx:if="{{product.tag}}" class="product-tag">{{product.tag}}</text>
    </view>

    <view class="product-content">
      <text class="title">{{product.title}}</text>
      <text class="product-subtitle">{{product.subtitle}}</text>

      <view class="product-meta">
        <view class="price-tag">
          <text class="currency">¥</text>
          <text class="amount">{{product.price}}</text>
          <text class="unit">起</text>
        </view>
        <text class="product-sales">{{product.salesText}}</text>
      </view>

      <view class="product-footer">
        <text class="original-price">¥{{product.originalPrice}}</text>
        <button class="cart-button" catchtap="addToCart" aria-label="加入购物车">+</button>
      </view>

</template>

<script>
import { createComponent } from '@mpxjs/core'

createComponent({
  properties: {
    product: {
      type: Object,
      value: () => ({})

  },
  methods: {
    selectProduct () {
      this.triggerEvent('select', { productId: this.product.id })
    },
    addToCart () {
      this.triggerEvent('addcart', { productId: this.product.id })
    }
  }
})
</script>
